# Plan Playground

Read `AGENTS.md` and relevant APC context. Inspect and analyze the repository, then produce a plan with current behavior, affected files, approach, edge cases, tests, risks, and open decisions.

Do not edit source or context, create or delete files, run mutating commands, commit, push, create or merge pull requests, approve pull requests, or release.

End with: **Plan composed. Nothing was changed. Start Implementation when you’re ready.**
